summary: CERTAIN MOTORCYCLES MAY HAVE BEEN PRODUCED WITH DEFECTIVE FUEL SHUT-OFF VALVES.  THE FUNCTIONALITY OF THE 'ON' POSITION AND THE 'RESERVE' POSITION OF THE VALVE MAY HAVE BEEN REVERSED.

summary: The bulbs can overheat and spark, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 158,000.

summary: Recalled ATVs were assembled with an incorrectly sized mounting bolt under the fuel tank. This could result in fuel leakage, presenting a fire safety hazard and risk of injury or death. Units: About 27,000.

title: CPSC, Polaris Industries Announce Recall of 900 Fusion, 900 RMK Snowmobiles
summary: The fuel connections between the fuel line and the fuel pump and fuel filter can leak. Failure of the fuel connection can result in leaking fuel and a possible fire, which can result in severe injury or death. In addition, the drive shaft may have been incorrectly heat treated, resulting in brittle

title: CPSC, Electrolux Home Products Inc. Announce Recall of Husqvarna Lawn Tractors
summary: These lawn tractors can develop abrasions on the fuel tank because of the fuel line clamp's location. This can result in a fuel tank leak, which could pose a fire hazard to consumers. Units: 5,280.

title: CPSC, Exmark Announce Recall of Lazer Z Zero Turn Radius Riding Lawn Mowers
summary: Due to the location of the fuel line on the Lazer Z EFI riding mowers, a hole can develop, resulting in a fuel leak that could present a fire hazard. Units: 1,215.

title: CPSC, Robert Bosch Tool Corp. Announce Recall of Skil® Table Saws
summary: The blade drive mechanism may loosen or the motor can separate from the tool. title: CPSC, Scag Power Equipment Announce Recall of Tiger Cub Lawn Tractors
summary: Fuel can leak out of the carburetor, posing a risk of fire and burn injuries. Units: About 16,000.

title: CPSC, LG Sourcing and Lowe's Announce Recall of GardenPlus Industrial Garden Carts
summary: Over-inflation of the tires can break the metal tire rim, causing users and bystanders to be struck with pieces of metal. Units: 196,788.

title: CPSC, Target Corp. Announce Recall of Suede Sandals
summary: The sole of the sandal can become slippery, causing the consumer to fall and receive bodily injury. Units: 1.2 million.

title: CPSC, AnnounceGE Security Inc. Retrofit/Recall of Smoke Detector Systems
summary: The smoke alarms can fail to activate during a fire or emergency, if installed in combination with certain control panels. Units: Approximately 246,800 smoke detectors.

title: CPSC, Crosman Corporation Announce Recall of Air Pistols
summary: The air pistols' safety might move from the engaged or "safe" position to the disengaged or "fire" position when the trigger is pulled once or more and then released. This poses a risk of serious injury if the air pistol is loaded and unintentionally fired. Units: About 24,000.

title: CPSC, Robertshaw Controls Company Announce Recall of Certain Models of 7000 Series Gas Control Valves
summary: Fire hazard. If the pilot light goes out, the gas valve could stick in an open position, permitting gas to continue to flow. This can result in a gas explosion and fire, which could result in severe personal injury or property damage. Units: About 425,000 gas control valves.

title: CPSC, Raymond Geddes Co. Announce Recall of Children's Necklaces
summary: The necklaces contain high levels of lead. title: CPSC, Swing-N-Slide® Corp. Announce Recall of Extra-Duty and Heavy-Duty Swing Seats
summary: A manufacturing defect can cause the metal grommet securing the seat to break. If this happens, the user can fall to the ground. Units: 72,000.

title: CPSC, First Team Inc. Announce Recall of Basketball Hoops
summary: The bolt attaching the arm to the vertical post can break, causing the backboard to fall and injure someone standing below. Units: About 7,600.
